name: Test-NetConnection
title: Test a Network Host and Service Port
summary: Tests name resolution, reachability, routing, or a specific TCP service port.

examples.description: Tests DNS resolution and TCP connectivity to HTTPS on the named host.

permissions.notes: Standard reachability and TCP tests usually do not require elevation.

risk.warning: Use only approved destinations; a failed test can reflect a firewall policy rather than an outage.

output_fields.name: TcpTestSucceeded
output_fields.description: Whether a TCP connection reached the requested port.

output_fields.name: SourceAddress
output_fields.description: Local address used for the test.

common_errors.meaning: The port is blocked, closed, filtered, or unreachable.
